title: NASA hopes the commercial space industry can help save Hubble
description: Gravity is a cruel mistress, slowly dragging the famed telescope ever closer to its ultimate demise with every day. Hubble is in no immediate danger of burning

content.summary: Gravity is a cruel mistress, slowly dragging the famed telescope ever closer to its ultimate demise with every day. Hubble is in no immediate danger of burning up in the Earth's atmosphere, but its time will run out in the early to mid 2030s unless its orbit is boosted. So NASA is taking proposals from the private sector to see if anyone can save it. In a post on NASA's site, Administrator Jared Isaacman said: "Hubble still has important science ahead of it, and we should be looking at every reasonable opportunity to keep it delivering for as long as possible … If there are innovative and cost-effective ways to extend the life of an asset … Read the full story at The Verge....

keyPoints: NASA is seeking help from the commercial space industry to extend the life of the Hubble Space Telescope.
The telescope is gradually losing altitude and is expected to re-enter Earth's atmosphere by the mid-2030s.
NASA is open to proposals from the private sector for missions to boost Hubble's orbit.
